name: Dimension-Filtered Positive Ample Classes Are Contained in Ample Classes
scope: Finite nonempty ample classes under the signed-coordinate and full ambient complement conventions; hierarchy parameters are held fixed.
statement: Every member of Dimension-Filtered Positive Ample Classes belongs to Ample Classes.
proof: Full nonnegative solutions satisfy all filtered sign constraints; the definition restricts the ambient class to ample inputs.
